# Aging cheese in a cave

Hard cheese develops its flavour over months of aging in a cool, humid cheese cave. A wine fridge set to 12 °C with a bowl of water works at home. Only wheels from [[Pressing hard cheese]] age this long.

Keep the cave near 85 percent humidity so the rind does not crack. Too damp, and unwanted mould takes over.

Turn each wheel weekly and wipe off unwanted mould with a cloth dipped in brine, or wax the cheese to keep it clean.
